name: bridge_guard_idle

Four subtle idle breathing phases: relaxed, inhale slightly, exhale half, return nearly relaxed. Chest/shoulders change at most one game pixel; a very small hem/cloak edge flutter. Four genuinely different frames, looping 8fps. Hard square pixels, top-left light, dark contour, <=48-color appearance, no antialias blur. Keep 2px clear margins. Do not enlarge face, add accessories or alter costume.
